title: Personal Injury Associate Attorney
summary: Remote personal injury litigation attorney, 2+ years’ experience. Work directly with Frank Penney and try cases. $150,000–$175,000 plus bonus and benefits.
intro: We’re looking for someone to bank on. We’re growing, and we’re adding a new Litigation Attorney seat. This is not a job where you’re one of 80 associates working a quota. We have six attorneys. You’ll work directly with our founder, try cases, and see the results of your work.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
items: Run a personal injury litigation caseload from filing through trial: auto, truck, motorcycle, pedestrian, premises liability, wrongful death, and TBI cases
Draft pleadings, discovery, and motions
Take and defend depositions, including experts
Handle hearings, mediations, and settlement negotiations
Try cases alongside Frank and our trial team
Work with your dedicated paralegal to keep every case moving

sections.heading: Why this role is different
items: **Learn from Frank Penney.** Frank was named the 2023 Consumer Attorney of the Year by Consumer Attorneys of California. The award recognized his $10.5M federal wrongful death verdict, which led to safety improvements in national parks across the country. He also serves as a Pro Tem Judge and Judicial Arbitrator in Placer County. You’ll work alongside him on case strategy and in trial.
**You’ll go to trial.** We prepare cases to be tried, and we try them. You’ll get courtroom experience that many 2–5 year attorneys never get.
**Small team, real access.** No layers of partners between you and the decisions. Your ideas get heard, and your wins get noticed.

**Built to last.** We have 30+ years of history, 11 locations across California, and a 10.0 Avvo rating. We’ve been named Super Lawyers Top 25 Sacramento and won Best of the Bar. This is a stable platform, not a startup gamble.

**We mean the mission.** We treat clients like family. That’s in our client reviews, and it’s how we give back. When we donated $12,000 to the Sacramento Children’s Home, we closed the office so the whole team could be there.

sections.heading: Qualifications
items: An active California State Bar license in good standing
2+ years of personal injury litigation experience

sections.heading: Required Skills
items: A fighter’s mindset: you push for full value, not the first offer
Strong writing, negotiation, and case management skills
The discipline to thrive working remotely, and willingness to travel for court

sections.heading: Pay range and compensation package
items: **Base salary:** $150,000–$175,000, depending on experience, plus bonus
**Fully remote:** live anywhere, and the firm pays your travel to court appearances
**Your own paralegal:** a dedicated paralegal on your cases
**Benefits:** health, dental, and vision insurance
**Retirement:** 401(k)
**Time off:** paid time off and paid holidays
**Professional costs:** bar dues paid by the firm

closing: Ready to fight for maximum results?

title: Law Firm Receptionist

salary.note: depending on experience and bilingual ability

summary: Full-time receptionist at our Roseville law office. Be the first voice injured clients hear. Conversational Spanish required. $20–$24/hour plus benefits.
intro: Be the first voice our clients hear. When someone calls Frank Penney Injury Lawyers, they’ve usually just had one of the worst days of their life: a car crash, a serious injury, a family in crisis. The person who answers sets the tone for everything that follows. We’re looking for that person. Since 1995, our firm has recovered more than $1 billion for injured Californians. We treat every client like family, and it starts at the front desk of our Roseville office.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
items: **Phones:** answer incoming calls with warmth and professionalism, and route them to the right attorney or team member
**New-client intake:** gather basic information from potential new clients and get them to our intake team quickly
**Visitors:** greet clients and visitors and make our office feel welcoming
**Calendars:** schedule appointments and help keep attorney calendars organized
**Mail and deliveries:** handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries, and courier pickups
**Front office:** keep the reception area clean, professional, and running smoothly

sections.heading: Required Skills
items: **Reliability:** you’re here, on time, every day. This matters more to us than anything else on this list. Our clients and team count on the front desk being covered.
**Calm under pressure:** you can handle upset callers with patience and compassion
**Communication:** clear and friendly, both on the phone and in person
**Organization:** you can juggle phones, visitors, and tasks without dropping anything
**Computer skills:** comfortable with email, calendars, and basic office software

sections.heading: Qualifications
items: **Conversational Spanish (required):** many of our clients speak Spanish, so being able to welcome them in their language makes a real difference

sections.heading: Pay range and compensation package
items: **Pay:** $20–$24 per hour, depending on experience and bilingual ability
**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., fully on-site at our Roseville office
**Benefits:** health, dental, and vision insurance
